list.title: Notes and research
list.desc: Your working notebook on the illness: links, articles, thoughts, answers from other AIs. .md files from Claude or ChatGPT can be imported as is. Any note can be reviewed with AI as it applies to this case.
list.emptyTitle: A place for everything you don't want to lose
list.notFoundDesc: Try a different search or remove the tag.
list.emptyDesc: Questions for the doctor, articles, thoughts, answers from other AIs. Create the first note or import .md files from chats.

note.confirmDelete: Delete the note along with its files?
note.filesHint: Images and PDFs for this note: articles, screenshots, discharge summaries. Text is extracted right away from PDFs with a text layer; scans and photos are transcribed by the fast model (“Full text (AI)”). AI reads the extracted text during review, and you can insert it into the note.
note.extractLlm: Text: {k}K characters, transcribed by the model
note.extractOcr: Text: {k}K characters, recognized from a scan
note.noExtractPdf: Text not extracted yet (AI won't see the file)
note.extractTextHint: Text layer of the PDF; scans and photos are recognized without AI: the file is not sent anywhere
note.summaryHint: Abstract: the gist of the document in 5–10 lines
note.llmHint: Word-for-word transcription by the model, needed for scans and photos
